error.account_id_required: Cannot parse Account Id from the refreshToken, please fill it in

user.title: Choose login method
user.description: Token login is recommended: paste a refreshToken captured from the TCL mini program. The integration will not perform an iOS login, so the TCL App on your phone stays signed in.

token.title: Token login (recommended)
token.description: Paste the refreshToken from the TCL mini program login response. Account Id can be left empty - it is parsed from the token. The access token auto-renews every 30 days, no further login needed.

data_description.account_id: Leave empty to parse it from the refreshToken payload
data_description.refresh_token: The refreshToken field in the /auth/thirdParty/bindUserByAuthCode response

password.title: Password login
password.description: Warning: this uses the iOS App channel and will sign the TCL App out on your phone.

sms_phone.title: SMS code login
sms_phone.description: Warning: this uses the iOS App channel and will sign the TCL App out on your phone.

account_sms_phone.title: SMS Login
account_sms_phone.description: Enter your phone number to receive a verification code

device.title: Device Filter
device.description: Exclude: checked devices will not be loaded. Include: only checked devices will be loaded.

entity_device_selector.title: Select Device
entity_device_selector.description: Please select the device to be operated

entity_filter.title: Entity Filter
entity_filter.description: Exclude: checked entities will not be loaded. Include: only checked entities will be loaded.

polling.title: State polling settings
polling.description: State changes arrive in real time over MQTT; polling is only a fallback used when nothing has been pushed for a long time. The actual interval gets a random jitter (up to 1.6x) and is reset by every incoming MQTT message, so an active device rarely triggers a request. Default 300 seconds, 0 disables polling.
